ZTS.output_conclusion: Zoetis（ZTS）在前一交易日盘后出现犬用螺旋蝇相关药物获监管放行的公司利好报道，但次日下跌仍与医疗保健板块普遍走弱一致。
ZTS.timeline_note: The scan covered 2026-08-13 after close through 2026-08-14 16:00 ET; later 2026-08-14 items were excluded from causal attribution.
